Delivered in three parts in section 6 of the record and NOT self-graded.

(a) IS A SOLE-WRITERSHIP LICENCE SAFE EVEN WHEN TRUE? No -- it is safe only for as long as it stays true, and nothing in the estate watches. Sole-writership is a fact about a POPULATION AT A DATE: it is not a property of the term, no namespace enforces it, and no gate refuses a new producer that starts emitting STORED_IN. CG-s-42 moved the licence from 'a comment a reader must believe' to 'a value a run can falsify', which is a real improvement and is not a guarantee. Three ways it could read green while being wrong, each stated: (1) it is REPOSITORY-SCOPED and blind to a producer that exists only as deployed bytes -- not hypothetical, since the very writer this cell named has an UNTRACKED materializer and only its output happens to be committed; the estate already counted 2 of 43 materializers missing from the repository. (2) IT RUNS WHEN SOMEONE RUNS IT: it is not wired into a commit gate and deliberately was not, because an agent-made gate nobody asked for is manufactured friction -- so the property is DESIRED with an EXERCISED proof for today's population and NO CADENCE, and a declared-but-unrun falsifier is a promise. (3) EMISSION-SHAPED MATCHING IS A DECLARED DOMAIN WITH AN UNCOVERED MEMBER: this order's own AC1 found the writer's name sitting in a DESCRIPTION no emission regex would match, so a check built on that shape inherits the same blind spot. WHAT WOULD ACTUALLY MAKE IT SAFE IS A DIFFERENT THING: a provenance stamp on the edge. Then the drop is MINE-shaped rather than TYPE-shaped and sole-writership stops being load-bearing. The producer's own docstring already says the distinguisher is missing (:491-493). THE LICENCE IS A WORKAROUND FOR AN ABSENT FIELD AND SHOULD BE READ AS ONE; building the field was out of scope -- this worker's own previous order refused the edge-side drop on the source's evidence, and re-opening it here would be widening.

(b) SHOULD THE RETIREMENT BE RE-ATTEMPTED ONCE THE LICENCE MOVES? Not as ruled, and the honest answer is that the ruling's PURPOSE has not been restated since its mechanism died. Reading 'precondition discharged' as 'proceed' would be wrong for three reasons. (1) THE RE-POINT IS A TWO-EDIT ACT AND ONLY ONE EDIT HAS EVER BEEN SCORED (row W2-S80): STITCH_EDGE_TYPES in derive_runner.py is the second gate, and a cut that scores only the emit repeats the exact defect round 8 repaired -- a requirement written onto a face with no criterion. (2) OWNED_BY IS POLYSEMOUS AND THE ESTATE HAS ALREADY RULED ON IT: cse_schema.map_cloudedge resolves it by DESTINATION TYPE (OWNS for an actor, CONTAINS for a container) and round 8 FAILED H1-AC5 for misreading that; collapsing a boundary edge onto a term whose meaning already depends on its target adds a second polysemy to a vocabulary that just finished paying for the first. (3) THE TWO TERMS DO NOT CURRENTLY MEAN THE SAME THING: STORED_IN is S3_DATA_KEY -> S3_BUCKET(arn) at key grain from this producer; graphuni-storage's OWNED_BY is S3Key -> arn at object/prefix grain from a FROZEN enumeration. They look alike, they are not the same population, and a retirement that merges them merges their denominators too. THE READING: what needs re-cutting is not the remedy's MECHANISM but its OUTCOME -- if the purpose was one boundary-edge vocabulary, the cheaper act is to state which term survives and migrate the READERS (comp_coverage_check's roll-up, cse_schema's resolver, cse_emit_graphhead's DST-typed bump) rather than make one producer's emit impersonate another's. That is a CTO call, named here rather than taken.

(c) IS THE UNCONDITIONAL SELF-DELETE A PATTERN TO CARRY ELSEWHERE? No. It is a compensation for an architecture that cannot tell WHOSE edge an edge is. It exists because the fold archives the derived graph, the producer reads that archive back as its INPUT, and the archive does not record who produced what -- so the producer can only distinguish 'mine from last night' from 'somebody else's' by TYPE, and type is a property of the CLASS, never of the AUTHOR. EVERY USE OF THIS PATTERN IS A BET THAT A CLASS HAS EXACTLY ONE AUTHOR, AND THE BET IS RE-RUN EVERY NIGHT WITHOUT ANYONE RE-CHECKING IT. Three properties make it worse than it looks: its failure is SILENT and fails in the safe-looking direction (a wrong delete produces a SMALLER graph, and smaller graphs read as clean -- round 8's own STORED_IN going to zero was caught only because somebody counted); its BLAST RADIUS IS NOT THE PRODUCER'S OWN OUTPUT, since the key is the type and the radius is every edge of that type from every author; and the LICENCE LIVES AT A DISTANCE FROM THE ACT -- the condition is about the ESTATE, the code is in one file, and nothing connected them at run time until this cell connected them for this one call site. THE GENERAL REMEDY IS NOT A BETTER LICENCE, IT IS PROVENANCE ON THE OBJECT: stamp the edge with its producer and drop what you WROTE, never what LOOKS LIKE what you wrote. Until then, the minimum bar where the pattern must exist is what CG-s-42 landed -- the condition as DATA, a REFUSAL rather than a silent pass, a counter on both branches, and a falsifier that can be re-run. A comment is not a control, and a control nobody runs is a comment with better punctuation.
